name: hearthline-member-request-operations
display_name: Hearthline Coworking — Member Request Operations & Autonomous Agent
description: Autonomous member request classification, multi-step agent toolchain, priority surfacing, billing discrepancy courtesy resolution, and human review/override portal for Hearthline Coworking.

datasets.description: Continuous stream of incoming member-submitted requests across shared workspace locations.

columns.name: body_text
columns.example: I was overcharged $34 on my monthly desk billing invoice.

datasets.description: Ground-truth billing ledger used by the autonomous agent to verify discrepancies.

columns.name: verified_discrepancy
columns.example: $34 overcharge verified: incorrect recurring locker fee added to September desk invoice

agents.name: Hearthline Member Success Agent
agents.trigger: Invoked automatically upon member request submission (POST /requests/ingest) or batch execution (POST /requests/batch-process)

stages.name: Intent Classification
stages.action: Classifies text into 5 coworking categories with confidence score and uncertainty flag.

stages.name: Duplicate & History Check
stages.condition: Always called. If genuine duplicate detected, executes auto_close_request and acknowledge_request.

stages.name: Context Retrieval for Uncertain Requests
stages.condition: Called if confidence < 0.70 or classification intent is ambiguous.

stages.name: Dynamic Priority Calculation
stages.action: Calculates urgency score (1 to 4) using keyword severity (lockouts, leaks) and Founding Member VIP boosts to surface urgent tickets first.

stages.name: Billing Discrepancy Verification & Autonomous Courtesy Resolution
stages.condition: Called when category is Billing and member describes a checkable discrepancy. Checks invoice.csv ledger and autonomously issues refund/credit.

stages.name: Autonomous Routing & Acknowledgment
stages.action: Routes to the assigned team queue and dispatches acknowledgment with resolution reference.

stages.name: State & Audit Trail Persistence
stages.action: Persists complete reasoning trace, tool calls, and status to SQLite database.

agents.name: Conversational Enterprise Assistant
agents.trigger: User chat requests via POST /ask or Slack events

agents.name: SLA Escalation Sweeper
agents.condition: Open tickets exceeding 24h SLA are auto-escalated to high priority.

tools.name: check_duplicate_or_history
tools.description: Searches past member request history for duplicate submissions or related open tickets.

tools.name: pull_additional_context
tools.description: Retrieves supplementary context (member plan, location, assigned desk, active badge ID, policies) when classification is uncertain.

tools.name: check_billing_record
tools.description: Inspects real invoice records and verified discrepancies in invoice.csv / database.

tools.name: issue_courtesy_resolution
tools.description: Autonomously issues courtesy credit, refund, or fee waiver when a verified billing discrepancy is identified.

tools.name: acknowledge_request
tools.description: Autonomously acknowledges member requests with personalized message and estimated resolution time.

tools.name: auto_close_request
tools.description: Autonomously closes genuine duplicate tickets and links to the active original ticket.

tools.name: auto_route_request
tools.description: Autonomously routes requests to designated team queues with calculated priority.

urgent.description: Immediate lockouts, active leaks, or VIP founding member emergencies

high.description: Equipment blockers, printer jams, or escalated items

medium.description: Standard business operations and room bookings

low.description: General inquiries or future month planning
